question: The Chief Minister of Delhi is appointed by the __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**President of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Chief Minister of Delhi is appointed by the **President of India** under Article 239AA of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The appointment is made following the recommendation of the party or coalition with the majority in the Delhi Legislative Assembly.
 
• Though the President formally appoints the Chief Minister, the **Lieutenant Governor of Delhi** administers the oath of office.
 
• The Chief Minister is the head of the Council of Ministers in Delhi and holds executive powers within the jurisdiction of the Delhi NCT (National Capital Territory).
 
• Delhi has a special status under the Constitution, as it is a Union Territory with a Legislative Assembly, unlike other Union Territories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 239AA:**

 
 
• Introduced through the 69th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1991, it provides special provisions for the National Capital Territory of Delhi.
 
• It allows for the establishment of a Legislative Assembly with elected representatives and a Council of Ministers headed by a Chief Minister.
 
• The Assembly can make laws on all matters in the State List and Concurrent List, except for police, land, and public order.
 
 
 
• **Lieutenant Governor of Delhi:**
 
 
• The Lieutenant Governor is the administrative head of Delhi and serves as the representative of the President of India in the Union Territory.
 
• All executive decisions of the Delhi government are communicated to the Lieutenant Governor.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Chief Minister in Delhi:**
 
 
• The Chief Minister is the executive leader of the Delhi government and heads the Council of Ministers.
 
• The Chief Minister is responsible for implementing laws passed by the Delhi Legislative Assembly and ensuring governance within the NCT.
 
 
 
• **Union Territories with Legislative Assemblies:**
 
 
• Delhi and Puducherry are the only Union Territories with legislative assemblies and Chief Ministers, giving them partial state-like governance powers.
 
• However, certain powers remain under the jurisdiction of the Central Government.
